'''Vakiir eggs''' were served as a breakfast food by [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]]. They were brown. Rodian merchant [[Teeloo]] cooked it for breakfast for him and his friend before racing through [[Eskaron]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].
